_doc: Rows excused from tools/check/tolerance-diff.mjs: {file, line, reason}. `line` is a substring of the ADDED assertion line. A row that matches nothing in the diff is reported stale; delete it. Every row needs a reason a reviewer can read (AGENTS.md rule 9: never widen a tolerance to get green).

exceptions.reason: Not a tolerance: the pinned value is the top of the car surface-id range in the WGSL classifier. Garage finishes add ids 36 (tinted chrome), 37 (chameleon) and then 38 (forged carbon), 39 (gunmetal), 40 (gold plate) under FINISH_RESERVED, so the classifier bound moves 33 -> 37 -> 40 in GLX, TLX and WGX together; the 18 design-lane finishes (ids 60-85, design wave 2 #3169) move it to 90 (the surface-id-parity headroom over the top shipped id, 85). car-materials/livery-finish-contract tests pin the new ids.

Layout foundation on deploy measured blocking 236233 B (ceiling 236800 B). Menu fit on #4179 adds ~2.5 KiB of first-paint rules in menu-destinations.css (play-door subtitles, wide-sheet measure, mb-vs en-dash guard). Post-merge measured 238718 B; the 239000 B ceiling is a bound on that census, not a drive-by widen.
